meta.title: Dress To Impress Runway Effects
meta.notes: Runway effects are treated as consumable/count-based uses because the Runway Effects page says the menu shows the total number remaining, and Spring Baddie Pass rows grant +3 Flower effects. Exact uses granted by standard and seasonal shop purchases are not listed in the checked sources.

items.name: Runway Tomato Pack
items.availability: Standard Shop purchase listed as available year-round.
items.effectBehavior: Throws tomatoes at the player currently on the runway.
items.chargesOrUseCount: Count-based uses. The menu shows total number remaining; exact uses granted by this purchase are not listed.
items.permanentBehavior: Not verified as an unlimited permanent unlock. Treat as charges unless a later in-game check proves otherwise.
items.updateContext: Released with Runway Chaos on September 27, 2025.
items.verificationNote: Standard table lists name, icon, tomato behavior, and 59 Robux price. Runway Effects page says effects are used during the final runway/voting stage and the menu shows remaining total.

items.name: Runway Flower Pack
items.sourceRoute: Spring 2026 seasonal update; seasonal currency shop and Spring Baddie Pass rewards
items.availability: Seasonal Spring 2026 route. The checked source lists the Spring Collection ending on June 4, 2026, so final publish should recheck current obtainability.
items.effectBehavior: Spawns flowers around the player currently on the runway.
items.chargesOrUseCount: Spring Baddie Pass lists +3 Flower Runway Effect rewards at tiers 10 and 16. Shop purchase quantity is not listed.
items.permanentBehavior: Owned seasonal effect charges stay usable after the event ends, according to the Runway Effects trivia note. This does not prove an unlimited permanent unlock.
items.updateContext: Added during Spring 2026 / Trip to Tokyo.
items.verificationNote: Seasonal table lists Flower at 50 Taiyaki. Spring Baddie Pass source gives +3 Flower rewards, supporting count-based use. Spring pages carry maintenance/outdated notices, so availability needs final live check before publishing.
